boundary: Post-primary orthogonal assembly-alignment context. Query segments represented only as insertions relative to the old assembly are excluded from aligned coverage. Old and new contig identifiers are not shared, so exact-name same-chromosome fields are not interpreted. Repetitive multi-mapping, assembly rearrangement, unresolved gaps and mapper heuristics prevent this from being independent copy-number truth. No primary prediction threshold or family catalogue may change from this audit.
